episode_row: GH #144: check-results/polling could score undelivered previews on skip days

commits.subject: feat(scheduler): write decision.json at finalization (commit/classification/crash/skip)
commits.body:
The scheduler becomes the SINGLE writer of an authoritative
data/picks/<date>/decision.json at true finalization points, tracking two
finalization-state variables (final_skip_candidate, committed_pick_written).
This is the linchpin for the GH #144 fix (Task 4 reads the record).

- FinalizationState + _row_from_daily + _write_{commit,classification,endofday_skip}
  helpers (best-effort via daily_decision.write_decision; never raise into the pick path).
- _deliver_and_lock_pick gains defaulted fs/selection params; each of its 5 lock
  branches records a scoreable commit (delivered/private_locked/locked_unconfirmed).
- run_single_check adds "selection" to every return dict (None only where genuinely
  absent: pre-cascade lock + ContestStateError).
- run_day owns fs: SETs the skip candidate on a genuine MDP skip, CLEARs only on a
  genuine pick attempt, and LEAVES it on a non-delivered classification so the #144
  skip survives to the end-of-day record. Single classification chokepoint; EOD skip
  write before the health-checks block.

Tests: helper unit tests + integration tests driving real run_day/_deliver_and_lock_pick.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): gate result-polling on a genuine commit (C2, GH #144)
commits.body:
run_day's result-polling block was gated only on state.pick_locked. A
NON-delivered classification-lock of a stale projected-preview <date>.json
sets pick_locked=True on an MDP-skip day, and run_result_polling ->
update_streak has no internal scoreable guard, so the stale preview got
scored and the streak corrupted -- bypassing the check-results scoreable
gate entirely.

Gate the polling entry additionally on is_scoreable_commit (D1): it defers
to decision.json's scoreable field, falling back to pick_was_delivered when
no record exists. state.pick_locked is left unchanged (it still gates the
shadow-model trigger, next-day lookahead, and the stop-lineup-checks break);
a non-committed classification-lock now locks for those purposes but is
never polled/scored.

Tests (test_scheduler_decision_record_integration.py): non-delivered
classified-lock on an MDP-skip day -> run_result_polling NOT entered, streak
unchanged; delivered pick -> polling IS entered. _drive_run_day gains an
optional poll_fn to inject a tracking mock.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): fallback honors a genuine MDP skip, not the stale cached preview (D4/C1, #144)
commits.body:
On the projected→real flip, the 3am preview writes a projected pick to
<date>.json, then real lineups make the day a genuine MDP skip. The fallback
re-evaluated, got pick_result is None (a real skip), and — treating it as "no
fresh pick, use cached" — delivered + locked + scored the stale preview on a
skip day. Closes Critical C1.

- _refresh_pick_at_fallback_decision carries selection=sel on the no-fresh-pick
  return so callers can tell a genuine MDP skip from a cascade/no-predictions
  (the except path stays selection=None → safety-net deliver).
- New _refresh_is_genuine_skip / _capture_fallback_skip helpers. The fallback
  re-captures the skip candidate (the earlier projected-pick cycle cleared it)
  so end-of-day still records the skip.
- Both fallback sites gate on a STANDING skip:
  skip_standing = _refresh_is_genuine_skip(refresh)
                  or (final_skip_candidate and not committed_pick_written).
  A confirmed skip survives a later transient refresh that flakes to
  selection=None (Codex r3) — never resurrect the cached pick. In-loop site
  `continue`s (loop exhausts → EOD); post-loop site falls through the try/else
  (no `continue` → EOD). Cascade safety-net (deliver cached) preserved only when
  NOT skip_standing.

Tests (tests/test_scheduler_decision_record_integration.py): selection carried on
genuine skip; no-predictions not a genuine skip; in-loop fallback re-captures skip
after a projected-pick clear (EOD writes skip, no delivery); cascade-error still
delivers cached (regression guard); r3 standing-skip survives a post-loop refresh
flake. Scoped scheduler regression + broad suite green (1470 passed).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(health): gate alert/health checks on decision record so skip days don't false-fire (D6, #144)
commits.body:
Three checks that read an undelivered pick file as a failure now respect the
deliberate-skip signal from the decision record or in-memory state:

1. _maybe_alert_missed_pick (scheduler.py): new `state` param; early-return when
   state.final_skip_candidate or state.skip_summary is set (pre-game; decision.json
   may not exist yet). Call site (~line 2202) threads `state` through.

2. post_failure.check: after confirming a pick exists, loads decision.json via
   load_decision(); skips the CRITICAL when action=="skip" or scoreable==False.

3. analytics_artifacts_missing._locked_pick_exists: replaces the
   `pick_locked or pick_was_delivered` heuristic with is_scoreable_commit() so a
   classification-lock on a skip day (pick_locked=True, decision scoreable=False)
   does not trigger shadow/capture artifact alerts.

Tests: 8 new tests (RED→GREEN verified); existing analytics tests updated to write
decision.json with scoreable=True so genuine-commit coverage is accurate. 398 pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): persist finalization state on SchedulerState across same-day restart (D5, #144)
commits.body:
Move final_skip_candidate + committed_pick_written off the run-local
FinalizationState (lost on a same-day daemon restart — deploys, Restart=always)
onto SchedulerState, which IS persisted to scheduler_state.json and carried
forward. After an MDP skip but before end-of-day, a restart now inherits the
captured skip so the EOD skip record still lands.

- SchedulerState: add final_skip_candidate / committed_pick_written (defaulted,
  so old scheduler_state.json still deserializes; asdict round-trips the dict).
- Drop FinalizationState; the helpers (_write_commit/_classification/_endofday)
  and _deliver_and_lock_pick operate on state directly (one finalization object).
- carry_forward_skip_state copies both new fields on a same-date restart.
- Save-ordering (#2a): _write_commit_decision sets the flag + save_state AFTER
  the decision write, so a restart can't lose committed_pick_written.
- Overwrite-guard (#2b): _write_endofday_skip no-ops if an on-disk scoreable
  decision.json already exists — never clobber a real commit with a skip.
- run_day persists state.final_skip_candidate immediately on SET/CLEAR.

D3's is_scoreable_commit result-polling gate (25aeaee) untouched.

Tests: 4 carry-forward tests (mirror skip_summary carry-forward) + 1 overwrite
-guard test; migrate decision-record tests fs= -> state=. Full scoped
regression 1465 passed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): standing skip must yield to a real late pick; clear skip_summary on flip; stricter load_decision (post-review)
commits.body:
Fix 1 (CRITICAL): both fallback sites suppressed a genuine late PICK when an
earlier cycle had set final_skip_candidate (skip_standing stayed True via the
candidate even though the refresh was a real single/double). Add
_refresh_is_genuine_pick and, at both sites, clear the standing skip (both
final_skip_candidate and skip_summary) on a genuine pick before computing
skip_standing. r3 no-resurrection case preserved: a selection=None flake is not a
genuine pick, so the candidate is NOT cleared and the skip still stands.

Fix 2: the run_day result block cleared final_skip_candidate on a pick but left
skip_summary set, so after a skip->pick flip a later undelivered pick had its
missed-pick alert (D6) wrongly suppressed. Clear skip_summary alongside it.

Fix 3: load_decision accepted schema-tagged but partial records (e.g. no action/
date), which could mis-authorize scoring a stale preview. Require action in
{skip,single,double}, bool scoreable, and a date. write_decision always emits
these, so genuine records are unaffected; two health-test helpers used a
non-production action='commit' placeholder, corrected to 'single'.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
